summary: Microsoft's voice assistant, named after a character in the Halo games. It was built into Windows Phone and then Windows 10, never caught up with its rivals, and was removed in stages in favour of Copilot.

events.note: Microsoft shows Cortana for Windows Phone.

events.label: Phone apps end
events.note: The Cortana apps for iOS and Android are shut down.

events.label: Notice
events.note: Microsoft says the Cortana app on Windows will stop being supported.
Support for the Cortana app on Windows ends late in the year.

cause: Dropped by Microsoft in favour of Copilot.
